reader.requirement: A sum counter may be qualified by the data-names of the report group entries above it and by the report-name, and by nothing above the report-name (a file-name whose REPORT clause names the report is refused as a qualifier).

edition-consulted.switches: the cited rule (§1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5 vs §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR4) in the no-match diagnostic; the walk is the same
below 2002 a sum counter named by a data-division clause operand, by the same walk; not the procedure-division path

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel in SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs (QualifierWalk has none) and SymbolTable.Reports.cs
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover qualification in general and a report-group qualifier; the probes add the report-name as the last qualifier, from a contained program, and the refusal of a file-name above it

probes.printed: COBOL2145 on T OF R1 OF RPF, T OF LN1 OF RPF, T OF RPF (cites §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5); COBOL5092 on DISPLAY LN1 and MOVE LN1 (cites §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR10d); COBOL2729 on unqualified LINE-COUNTER with two reports; COBOL2729 on LINE-COUNTER OF R2 and PAGE-COUNTER OF R2 in the contained program (R2 not GLOBAL); COBOL1757 GENERATE D2
probes.expected: a qualifier above the report-name refused (SUM SR5); a format 2 data-name used other than to qualify a sum counter refused (SR7); a non-GLOBAL report's counters unknown in a contained program (X.4.4.4 GR1)

contained program reads unqualified LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER OF R1 of the container's GLOBAL report (its only visible report), alters PAGE-COUNTER and sum counter T OF LN1, and the container sees the same registers
middle program's GLOBAL TOT is nearer for unqualified TOT (GR3b1); TOT OF CFG OF R1 the outer's sum counter (GR1/GR2)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5" "The highest permissible qualifier of a sum counter is the report-name")
OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR3  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:XIII.3.5.3 SR3" "Report-name-1 is the highest permissible qualifier")

reader.notes: T OF LN1 OF CFG OF R1 and T IN LN2 OF R1 resolve (also from a contained program); T OF R1 OF RPF, T OF LN1 OF RPF and T OF RPF are refused with COBOL2145 citing this rule. QualifierWalk lets only the report-name stand as the outermost qualifier for a counter.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the 1985-only path the reader listed but did not probe: at COBOL-85 a sum counter may be named by a Data Division clause of another section (SymbolTable.Reports.cs#SumCounterOperand85, gated on DialectLevel < 2002, reached from Passes/OdoResolvePass.cs). sr5a.cob (01 TB. 05 E PIC X OCCURS 1 TO 9 DEPENDING ON T OF CFG OF R1, T a sum counter of CF FINAL): --std 85 EXIT 0, 'TB=ZZZ|' (sum 2+1 = 3 occurrences): qualification up to the report-name accepted. sr5b.cob (the same with DEPENDING ON T OF R1 OF RPF, a file-name above the report-name): EXIT 65, 'sr5b.cob(13,11): error COBOL0851: OCCURS DEPENDING ON 'T OF R1 OF RPF' on 'E': data-name-1 is not defined under the given qualifiers': refused, as SR5 requires; SumCounterOperand85 uses the same QualifierWalk whose outermost qualifier must equal the report-name. Diagnostic lead (misleads-diagnosis, minor): at --std 85 COBOL0851 cites §2023:8.4.2.2.1, not §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5 as the Procedure Division path's COBOL2145 does. The reader's rptref covers the Procedure Division refusals. No probe overturned. Citation: OK §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5 ('The highest permissible qualifier of a sum counter is the report-name').
